summary: Rabbi Harari examines the latest time to finish Shnayim Mikra ve'Ehad Targum on Shabbat, focusing on the statement in Shohan Arukh that the most choice way is before eating. He explores whether finishing the Parasha after the Shabbat morning meal is still Lecha Tehillah or Bedi'avad. He reviews opinions from Tosafot, Hakham Ovadia Yosef, the Rosh, Rabbeinu Menahem Recanati, Kaf HaHayim, and Rabbi Meir Mazuz.
